rules.title: Broker fee paid only by the party who hired the broker
rules.requirement: A rental broker's fee may be charged only to the party (landlord or tenant) who originally hired and contracted with the broker. A tenant cannot be made to pay a broker fee for a broker the landlord engaged.
rules.key_value: Broker fee payable only by the party who engaged the broker
rules.citation: M.G.L. c. 112, § 87DDD1/2 (as amended by St. 2025, c. 9, § 43)
rules.quoted_span: Any fee shall only be paid by the party, lessor or tenant who originally engaged and entered into a contract with the licensed broker or salesperson.
rules.coverage_text: Licensed brokers or salespersons finding dwelling accommodations for prospective tenants for a fee
rules.conflict_note: The page shows both the prior text, effective until August 1, 2025, and the amended text, effective August 1, 2025. The fee-payment rule appears only in the amended text. This rule restricts upfront broker fees rather than application or screening fees, so the category fit is approximate.
